question: Who has been appointed as the brand ambassador for the Viksit Bharat Buildathon 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shubhanshu Shukla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Group Captain Shubhanshu Shukla, the first Indian to reach the International Space Station (ISS), has been appointed as the brand ambassador of Viksit Bharat Buildathon 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Viksit Bharat Buildathon 2025 is India’s largest-ever school hackathon, aiming to engage over one crore students from 1.5 lakh schools across India.**
 
• **Organized by the Ministry of Education in collaboration with Atal Innovation Mission (AIM), NITI Aayog, and AICTE, the Buildathon invites students to ideate, design, and build prototypes addressing real-world challenges.**
 
• **The Buildathon was launched on 23 September 2025 and will engage students from Classes VI to XII.**
 
• **The event is guided by four national themes: Atmanirbhar Bharat, Swadeshi, Vocal for Local, and Samriddhi.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Viksit Bharat Buildathon__

 __
 
• India's largest school hackathon, designed to encourage innovation and problem-solving skills among students across the nation.
 
 
 
• Atmanirbhar Bharat__
 __
 
• A vision for a self-reliant India, focusing on boosting domestic production and reducing dependency on imports.
 
 
 
• Atal Innovation Mission (AIM)__
 
 
• A flagship initiative by NITI Aayog to promote innovation and entrepreneurship in India through various schemes and programs.
